rows.text: "The mist is heavy, and stars shine at high noon"... Oh my. A divination here in Planarcadia indicates the Limping hexagram. Definitely not a lucky draw.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: You're an honest, curious one, aren't you? Reminds me of my junior soror. I'll break it down for you: If you can see starlets at high noon, it means their light is drowning out the sun, which is never a good sign.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: And the next part says "the right arm is broken, but no one is to blame." I'm afraid you'll be stuck in a rut lately, and might even bring harm upon yourself. A single mistake could ruin everything as your luck runs out...
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: A bad sign? How do I fix this?
How should I know? I'm just gonna pack my bags and head back to the Yuque!
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Tell Qingque to hurry up and leave the Luofur to serve as my envoy to Planarcadia. That's the plan! I'm leaving.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Your furbo speaking habits just gave you away.
Boss, for your information, I've mastered the Hexagram myself. I'm just as sharp at divination as Madam Yao!
rows.speaker: Forkbo

rows.text: But that's just how people are these days. If you don't dress up as Madam Yao and put on the whole act, no one's gonna take those words seriously.
rows.speaker: Forkbo

rows.text: No matter, even if you've seen through me, in Madam Yao's esteemed words, my insights about the arcadia has gotten more profound...
rows.speaker: Forkbo

rows.text: I heard that other furbos who do roleplay always end up fighting you when they get busted. Not that I'm planning to do that... but if I deliberately stand out from the crowd, my coworkers are bound to give me a hard time later.
rows.speaker: Forkbo

rows.text: Boss, sorry about this, but I'm gonna have to ask you to spar with me!
rows.speaker: Forkbo

rows.text: Phew, guess that'll do for an explanation. To spar with the boss myself... what an honor!
rows.speaker: Forkbo

rows.text: "Fire and water are irreconcilable... their ambitions incompatible." Mm-hmm, rivalry between presidents has always been this way. I can smell the creative inspiration in the air...
rows.speaker: Forkbo

rows.text: Well then, I'm off to craft a story about you two bosses clashing! Bye, boss! Let's hope I create something truly magnificent~
rows.speaker: Forkbo
